content.query: WITH CTE1 AS( SELECT TRY_CAST(COUNT(*) as numeric(25,5)) COUNT_tgt , isnull(sum(TRY_CAST(TRAN_AMT as numeric(25,5))),0) TRAN_AMT_tgt , FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CBC01_DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE WHERE H = 'D' GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM ) , CTE2 AS ( SELECT TRY_CAST(REPLACE(H,'F-','') as numeric(25,5)) COUNT_src , TRY_CAST(TRAN_AMT as numeric(25,5))  TRAN_AMT_src , FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CBC01_DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE WHERE H <> 'D' ) , CTE12 as ( SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT , TRAN_AMT_tgt , TRAN_AMT_src , A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, TRY_CAST((left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8)) as DATE) DATE FROM CTE1 A JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM ) INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL] SELECT FILE_NAME ,DATE ,insert_dttm ,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS ,SRC ,TGT FROM ( SELECT TRY_CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC ,TRY_CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT ,TRY_CAST(TRAN_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TRAN_AMT_tgt ,TRY_CAST(TRAN_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TRAN_AMT_src ,FILE_NAME ,INSERT_DTTM ,[DATE] FROM CTE12 ) pvt UNPIVOT ( SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC , TRAN_AMT_src ) ) pvt1 UNPIVOT ( TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT , TRAN_AMT_tgt ) ) pvt2 WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
